source: Council Directive 2006/112/EC on the common system of value added tax, Title XI Chapter 3 (invoicing), as amended: Art. 219, 219a, 226, 230 and 248a. Only the requirements are cited; no text is copied beyond the mentions the Directive itself prescribes.

rules.text: A reverse-charge invoice carries the mention Reverse charge in the page's language, and an invoice in a currency other than the seller's national one states the VAT in the national currency too.
The page is in the customer's language when the order names one, else the seller's country's, whose rules govern the invoice; a language the pack has no words for is written in English.
rules.source: Directive 2006/112/EC Art. 219a (whose rules apply) and Art. 248a (a state may ask for a translation); Stripe sets the invoice language per customer

rules.text: A document that amends an invoice, such as a credit note, counts as an invoice when it refers to that invoice specifically and unambiguously: it names the invoice it amends and carries what an invoice must carry.
rules.source: Directive 2006/112/EC Art. 219 (amending documents) and Art. 226 (the particulars of an invoice)
